items.title: Deploy with Void

sentences.en: Deploy with Void.

VoidZero's tools such as Vite, Vitest, Oxc, and Rolldown — bundled in one toolchain as Vite+ — have made frontend development faster, but building full-stack applications requires more than just a tooling stack.
These applications need server routes, databases, local development environments, and a fast and easy way to deploy ideas to production.
We’re excited to open-source three new products that bring server routing, typed data access, and Cloudflare deployment into a unified Vite workflow.
Void Platform: A shared deployment platform for teams to host Void apps on Cloudflare.
Void SDK: A composable JavaScript SDK for building full-stack apps with Vite.
Void CLI: A CLI for provisioning resources and deploying Vite apps to Cloudflare.
The CLI deploys apps built with the SDK to the Platform.
All three products are open-sourced as a single JavaScript package and Vite plugin that you can install via npm install void .
With Void , you can build your server and client together, carry types from your database to the UI, and let Void automatically provision the Cloudflare resources that your app uses.
We originally set out to build a single, private platform for all users to deploy apps to.

After VoidZero joined Cloudflare , we adjusted our direction to open-source the platform and allow anyone to install because we saw a growing need: companies want to encourage vibe-coded internal apps, but are concerned about security and do not want to give cloud access to every employee .

items.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI: Making AI discovery better for everyone

sentences.en: Cloudflare and OpenAI: Making AI discovery better for everyone.
Optimizing your site for AI is of little use if AI can't find it.

The answer to someone's question may already be on your website: the installation guide you spent a week writing, or a first-hand account of using a product, with the details that make the difference for whether they buy it.
As more people turn to AI for help, you want those systems to find your work, represent it accurately, and send interested people your way.
You also want control over how they access your site.
Cloudflare and OpenAI launched a research pilot in July 2026 with those interests in mind.
We wanted to find out whether signals from Cloudflare’s network could help ChatGPT users discover new content more efficiently.
Today, we’re sharing early results.

So far, the answer is a resounding yes: the pilot has brought previously unknown pages into OpenAI’s search index, giving ChatGPT more sources to draw on to help people find relevant, timely information.
Along the way, we’ve learned more about what makes a page worth discovering and how AI systems use the web.
Finding more of the web The web is full of specifics.
Someone fixing a washing machine needs the manual for their exact model.

items.title: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move

sentences.en: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move.
Following reported strikes on Yandex data centers, claims circulated on the Internet that Russian bot farms and influence operations had been knocked offline.
HTTP traffic charts showed steep drops, fueling speculation that the infrastructure damage had stopped these malicious actors.
However, aggregate traffic metrics can easily mislead.
There are two autonomous system numbers ( ASNs ) associated with Yandex: AS13238 is used by Yandex’s search engine, while AS200350 runs its cloud services.
Using Cloudflare Radar and Bot Management data, we analyzed how these two ASNs were affected — and while both saw drops in traffic, they saw differing impact.
Yandex Search (AS13238) : The drop in traffic consisted almost entirely of verified search crawlers indexing web pages, images, and site resources.

Yandex.Cloud (AS200350): There was a decline in malicious activities like vulnerability scanning and probing, but high-volume automation did not vanish — it simply migrated to other hosting providers.
While malicious traffic may originate from a particular provider, it does not necessarily tell us who is responsible for the traffic.
Understanding why the strikes had little lasting effect on malicious traffic requires analyzing request behavior, rather than just overall traffic patterns.

What happened: the effect of the strikes and pre-event baseline Between October 7 and 11, reported Ukrainian drone strikes hit three Yandex facilities in Russia, progressively knocking data centers and network capacity offline.

As seen on Cloudflare Radar , this culminated in a near-total collapse of the Yandex network on October 11 when traffic plummeted to 99% below baseline for Yandex Search (AS13238) and 90% for Yandex.Cloud (AS200350).

items.title: GitHub availability report: September 2026

sentences.en: GitHub availability report: September 2026.
sentences.zh: GitHub可用性报告： 2026年9月。

sentences.en: Our last update covered content through August.
sentences.zh: 我们的上次更新涵盖了截至8月的内容。

sentences.en: We did not publish another in September while other public content addressed the August 17 outage.
sentences.zh: 我们在9月份没有发布另一个，而其他公共内容则涉及8月17日的服务中断。

sentences.en: This edition covers progress over the past two months.
sentences.zh: 本期涵盖了过去两个月的进展情况。

sentences.en: The short version of August and September : we reduced shared-database pressure, added overload controls, created headroom for GitHub Actions, expanded failure containment for pull requests, and moved more production workloads to Azure.
sentences.zh: 8月和9月的简短版本：我们减少了共享数据库压力，添加了过载控制，为GitHub Actions创建了空间，扩展了拉取请求的失败控制，并将更多生产工作负载移至Azure。

sentences.en: Significant incidents, a capacity pause, and a missed migration target show that the work is not complete.
sentences.zh: 重大事件、容量暂停和错过迁移目标表明工作未完成。

sentences.en: By October 7, 120 of 160 production services were deployed in Central US, and 13 of 51 primary MySQL databases had moved.
sentences.zh: 截至10月7日， 160个生产服务中的120个部署在美国中部， 51个主要MySQL数据库中的13个已迁移。

sentences.en: Azure also handled 65.4% of read traffic for GitHub s core application, 48.3% of Git read traffic, and 80.2% of stream-processing traffic.
sentences.zh: Azure还处理了GitHub核心应用程序65.4%的读取流量、48.3%的Git读取流量和80.2%的流处理流量。

sentences.en: These percentages measure different workloads and should not be added.
sentences.zh: 这些百分比衡量不同的工作量，不应添加。

sentences.en: We paused Central US deployments and traffic increases on September 11 because capacity was uneven across availability zones.
sentences.zh: 我们在9月11日暂停了美国中部的部署和流量增长，因为各个可用区域的容量不均匀。

sentences.en: Permanent ramps resumed September 18 after temporary relief, but durable capacity work continues, with a goal of unlocking all available capacity by the end of October.
sentences.zh: 在暂时缓解后，永久性坡道于9月18日恢复，但持久的容量工作仍在继续，目标是在10月底之前释放所有可用容量。

sentences.en: We missed our aggressive September 30 goal to deploy every production service there.
sentences.zh: 我们错过了9月30日激进的目标，即在那里部署所有生产服务。

items.title: Amazon S3 is now available on the Vercel Marketplace and v0 by Vercel

sentences.en: Amazon S3 is now available on the Vercel Marketplace and v0 by Vercel.
sentences.zh: Amazon S3现已在Vercel Marketplace和v0 by Vercel上提供。

sentences.en: Developers building web and AI applications on Vercel can now add Amazon S3 storage resources directly from the Vercel Marketplace and v0, combining the durability, scalability, and performance of S3 with the convenience of Vercel’s provisioning workflow.
sentences.zh: 在Vercel上构建Web和人工智能应用程序的开发人员现在可以直接从Vercel Marketplace和v0添加Amazon S3存储资源，将S3的耐用性、可扩展性和性能与Vercel的配置工作流程的便利性相结合。

sentences.en: Starting today, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) , including Amazon S3 Tables and Amazon S3 Vectors , is natively available on the Vercel Marketplace and v0 by Vercel , covering three distinct workloads: everyday storage, analytics, and AI.
sentences.zh: 从今天开始， Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) （包括Amazon S3 Tables和Amazon S3 Vectors ）在Vercel Marketplace和v0 by Vercel上原生可用，涵盖三种不同的工作负载：日常存储、分析和人工智能。

sentences.en: Why this matters Millions of developers build, deploy, and scale web and AI applications on Vercel.
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要数百万开发人员在Vercel上构建、部署和扩展Web和人工智能应用程序。

sentences.en: Storage is essential to performant applications, but provisioning it previously required navigating to the AWS Management Console to configure policies and credentials.
sentences.zh: 存储对于高性能应用程序至关重要，但之前配置存储需要导航到AWS管理控制台以配置策略和凭据。

sentences.en: Now, S3 storage integrates directly into the Vercel developer experience, with resource provisioning and connection configuration handled automatically.

Together with existing integrations for Amazon Aurora , Amazon DynamoDB , and Amazon OpenSearch Serverless , you get a complete application stack inside Vercel (from your database layer through to object, vector, and open table storage), all on one AWS account with one bill.

Storage for every application S3 general purpose buckets : Store virtually unlimited objects, including files, images, videos, and documents, for data lakes, cloud-native applications, and mobile apps.
S3 delivers the most durable storage in the cloud, designed to provide 99.999999999% (11 nines) data durability and 99.99% availability by default.
S3 Tables : Fully managed Apache Iceberg storage optimized for analytics with automated table maintenance and compaction.
S3 Tables are directly queryable from any Iceberg REST catalog API-compatible engine, including DuckDB.

S3 Vectors : Purpose-built vector storage and query for AI applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search, reducing the cost of uploading, storing, and querying vectors by up to 90%.

items.title: From 2,500 requests to 24: Rebuilding star history without the stargazers

sentences.en: From 2,500 requests to 24: Rebuilding star history without the stargazers.
sentences.zh: 从2500个请求到24个：在没有观星者的情况下重建明星历史。

sentences.en: Maintainers look at star history to answer a practical question: did a launch, release, or event change a project s trajectory?
sentences.zh: 维护人员查看STAR历史记录以回答一个实际问题：启动、发布或事件是否改变了项目的轨迹？

sentences.en: To reconstruct that curve from the GitHub API, tools had to request pages of stargazer records (each person who currently stars the repository and when they starred it), keep the timestamps, and throw the identities away.
sentences.zh: 为了从GitHub API重建该曲线，工具必须请求stargazer记录页面（当前为存储库加星标的每个人以及他们加星标的时间） ，保留时间戳，并丢弃身份。

sentences.en: Over time, that design created problems at both ends.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这种设计在两端都产生了问题。

sentences.en: Identities were available for bulk collection, so bad actors started scraping public stargazer lists for spam and phishing campaigns.
sentences.zh: 身份可用于批量收集，因此不良行为者开始抓取垃圾邮件和网络钓鱼活动的公共观星者列表。

sentences.en: For highly starred repositories, the endpoint could also make the database process many thousands of entries to return a single page.
sentences.zh: 对于高度加星标的存储库，端点还可以使数据库处理数千个条目以返回单个页面。

sentences.en: The fix seemed clear: return counts instead of people.
sentences.zh: 修复似乎很清楚：返回计数而不是人。

sentences.en: But returning less data didn t actually make the query any cheaper.
sentences.zh: 但是，返回较少的数据实际上并没有使查询更便宜。

sentences.en: Now maintainers have a direct way to get the curve: we built an endpoint that returns up to 30 weeks of daily star counts in a single request, with no identities attached.
sentences.zh: 现在，维护人员可以直接获取曲线：我们构建了一个端点，该端点在单个请求中返回长达30周的每日星级计数，并且没有附加标识。

sentences.en: Keeping that cheap to serve meant reducing how much data the database processed, not just how much it returned, and the endpoint does that by filtering stars by time before it counts anything .
sentences.zh: 保持这种廉价的服务意味着减少数据库处理的数据量，而不仅仅是它返回的数据量，端点通过在计算任何数据之前按时间过滤星星来实现这一点。

sentences.en: What maintainers need from star history We first addressed the immediate risks to developers and to our database by restricting stargazer and watcher lists to repository administrators and collaborators .
sentences.zh: 维护人员需要从STAR历史记录中获得什么我们首先通过将stargazer和观察者列表限制为存储库管理员和协作者来解决开发人员和数据库的直接风险。

sentences.en: After the access change, callers without the required permission could receive an empty response or a 403 Forbidden response.
sentences.zh: 访问权限更改后，没有所需权限的调用方可能会收到空响应或403禁止响应。

items.title: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp

sentences.en: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending?
Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp.
You submit a Kubernetes Job and wait for its Pods to appear.
A minute passes.
Then another.
The Job is still suspended, there are no application logs, and there may not even be a Pod to inspect.
In a cluster managed by Kueue , this can be completely normal.
Kueue may still be deciding whether the Job can use the requested resources.
The useful question is not only “Why is the Pod pending?” It is first “Has Kueue admitted the Workload?” The Kueue plugin for Headlamp brings that investigation into the Headlamp UI.

Instead of reconstructing the admission path from several commands and large YAML objects, you can begin with the Workload, read its condition message, and follow links through the LocalQueue, ClusterQueue, ResourceFlavor, and Cohort.
This article follows that Headlamp-first path.
The command line appears only in a short optional section for reproducing the example.
